author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
## Authorized scope
Product and Code Owner Ingolf Lohmann authorized application of the Claude Max/Team API-credit recommendation on 2026-10-09 ("Freigabe zur Anwendung erteilt"). Apply this as bounded implementation work for the personal Firefox MVP; no subscription purchase, credit claim, auto-reload activation, credential publication, license acceptance, release or deployment is authorized by this handoff.

## Exact observed subject
Repository: ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt
Main HEAD: 502229de5259080939b54ec99dd131a7c96f476c
Root tree: 4c60f64a2646f77403587c16fda4173833fcb03b
Routing: GITHUB_ROUTE=REST_API_ONLY
The observed policy/CANONICAL_UPSTREAM_REMOTE_V1.json identifies Goldkelch/qik-vrt as AUTHORITY and this repository as MIRROR. The direct authenticated REST GET of https://api.github.com/repos/Goldkelch/qik-vrt/commits/main returned HTTP 404. This does not establish deletion, suspension or a cause.
The personal capability boundary denies personal-state/credential transfer to the standard package. Its current manifest/runtime acceptance remains HOLD; no historical evidence is transferred.

## Source-bound change to assess
Announced 2026-10-07: Max and Team now include monthly direct Claude Platform API credits.
Sources:
- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes
- https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/api-credits-for-subscribers
- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17154008-monthly-api-credits-for-max-and-team-plans

Documented allocations: Max 5x USD 100/month, Max 20x USD 200/month; Team USD 20/Standard seat or USD 100/Premium seat pooled up to USD 500/month. Unused credits expire each billing cycle; claim requires an eligible plan active for seven days and one linked Console organization. Credits are separate from consumer limits and third-party cloud billing. Revalidate exact current terms before implementing entitlement logic. Account eligibility, actual credit deposit, expiry and balance are NOT observed.

## Smallest continuation and acceptance criteria
1. Restore/resolve a readable canonical Authority HEAD/TREE through the existing REST connection; complete /AI -> AI_CONTEXT.json required_read_order and normal read-only boot gates. Do not bypass governance or substitute browser login.
2. Inventory the existing model/provider adapter, budget and entitlement implementation before adding code (REUSE_BEFORE_CREATE). Search here found CLAUDE.md/AI_ADAPTERS instruction bindings; that is not evidence of a functioning Claude API adapter.
3. Prepare a reviewable compatible candidate in the appropriate personal work scope: separate consumer plan, Console organization, API credits, expiry and purchased balance; do not hard-code an unverified balance from plan name.
4. Evaluate total cost only for an already-needed subscription with France-specific currency/tax/billing period; do not justify a subscription purchase from nominal USD credits alone.
5. Define budget warning and hard-stop/reservation behavior, stale/unknown/expired-credit handling, rate-limit handling, and an explicitly configured provider/local fallback. An ambiguous external effect must be read back rather than blindly retried or replayed on another provider.
6. Tests must cover zero/expired/unknown balance, concurrency reservation, cycle rollover, exhaustion, and timeout-after-effect without duplicate actions. API success/transport acknowledgement must not imply EFFECT_ACK_DONE.
7. Keep secrets in the supported secure credential store; preserve personal-to-standard capability boundaries and commercial licensing review separately from credit entitlement.
8. Bind candidate tests, provenance, required gates and independent effect readback to the exact successor HEAD/TREE; report implementation, tests, account activation and production acceptance separately.

## Current disposition
AUTHORITY_READBACK_UNAVAILABLE_HTTP_404.
No Claude runtime integration, credit activation, boot PASS, Mesh dispatch, deployment or EFFECT_ACK_DONE is claimed.
The currently exposed connector has repository reads and issue writes but no callable workflow_dispatch operation. The read workflow-executor contract authorizes only a bounded watchdog dispatch, not arbitrary provider-adapter implementation.
Retry condition: canonical Authority read recovered and a suitable authorized executor or verified working-copy path established.
This issue is durable task/blocker persistence, not evidence that a Mesh executor has begun execution.

## Attribution
Human: Ingolf Lohmann — approval and product scope.
Artificial-cognitive: Codex — readback, task decomposition and this issue text.
title: Apply Claude API-credit budgeting to personal Firefox MVP — exact-bound continuation
